surveillance_source: WOAH/WAHIS & NTCA Wild Tiger Health Project

active_disease_events.location: Pilibhit & Dudhwa Tiger Reserves, Uttar Pradesh, India
active_disease_events.clinical_manifestation: Myoclonus (muscle twitching), respiratory distress, abnormal fearlessness toward humans, ataxia
active_disease_events.control_measures: Buffer zone domestic dog vaccination, quarantine of stray canines, contact tracking

active_disease_events.location: Mudumalai Tiger Reserve, Tamil Nadu, India
active_disease_events.clinical_manifestation: Progressive emaciation, pulmonary granulomas, chronic coughing, lethargy
active_disease_events.control_measures: Fringe livestock tuberculin testing, carcass safe incineration, grazing restrictions in core buffer

active_disease_events.clinical_manifestation: Intermittent high fever, severe anemia, subcutaneous edema, bilateral corneal opacity
active_disease_events.control_measures: Vector fly control around waterholes, prophylactic diminazene diaceturate in monitored individuals

active_disease_events.location: Captive and Rescue Centers / Bordering Wild Sanctuaries
active_disease_events.clinical_manifestation: Hyperacute severe hemorrhagic pneumonia, neurologic signs, acute recumbency
active_disease_events.control_measures: Raw poultry feeding ban, migratory waterbird carcass containment, biosecurity cordons

active_disease_events.clinical_manifestation: Hyper-aggression, unprovoked attacks, hyper-salivation, hydrophobia, paralysis
active_disease_events.control_measures: Rapid response darting team notification, post-exposure human prophylaxis, buffer canine vaccination

active_disease_events.clinical_manifestation: Severe bloody diarrhea, acute dehydration, profound leukopenia, high cub mortality
active_disease_events.control_measures: Disinfection of water troughs, feral feline deterrents

Shivalik Hills & Gangetic Plains.recommended_buffer_protocol: Compulsory canine ring-vaccination within 10 km buffer

Central India & Eastern Ghats.recommended_buffer_protocol: Fly trap deployment at water sources, anti-poaching snare sweeps

Western Ghats.recommended_buffer_protocol: Livestock tuberculin screening at park boundaries, strict grazing exclusion

North East Hills & Brahmaputra.vector_parasite_risk: High (humid monsoon leech and tick vectors)
North East Hills & Brahmaputra.recommended_buffer_protocol: Wildlife rescue quarantine protocol and acaricidal treatments

Sundarbans.recommended_buffer_protocol: Pugmark tracking, freshwater pond monitoring, tidal rescue units
